title: 어제와 같은 백반
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with R&B influences. The arrangement features a clean, reverb-heavy electric guitar playing arpeggiated chords and a deep, sub-heavy synth bass. A steady electronic kick drum provides a rhythmic pulse at 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocals are a soft, intimate male baritone with significant proximity effect and plate reverb. High-frequency foley sounds, including water droplets and mechanical hums, are layered into the mix. The track is in the key of C Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[reverb-heavy electric guitar arpeggio]
[water droplet foley]

[Verse 1]
[soft male vocals]
하루가 끝났어 [sub-bass enters]
욕조에 물을 받았어 들어갔어
따뜻해 천장을 봤어
수도꼭지에서는 물이 한 방울씩 떨어져 [water droplet sound]
냉장고가 돌아가 벽 너머 TV 소리가 들려
소리가 많더라 이 세상은

[Chorus]
고개를 뒤로 젖혔어
귀가 물에 잠겼어 [muffled filter effect]
소리가 사라졌어
전부 사라졌어
수도꼭지도 [kick drum enters]
